# RelHubRings4

Four disciplines contained in one system.

## When to use it

Four capabilities that live INSIDE one system rather than beside each other, with prose to land the claim.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | F-relational |
| Form | orbit |
| Arity | 4 |
| Ground | cream |
| Density | standard, about 560 characters |
| Media | motif |
| Focal | hub at 275px against a 64px headline (ratio 4.3) |

## Why it holds together

The hub disc, measured as diameter. It is the only orange fill and the largest single object; that is what makes it read as the centre rather than a fifth node.

## Related kit layout

`OrbitV1` — OrbitV1 draws thin outline rings around a navy hub and carries a headline and one line. Keep both: v1 for a light touch, this when the containment claim is the point and there is prose to support it.

## Deviations from the traced source

| What | Source | Here | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| curved text and halftone wordmark on the outer ring | present | dropped | Bespoke artwork, not system elements. A curved text run is not something the kit can express, and teaching it to would licence per-slide typography. |

## What the consumer supplies

Copy only. The geometry is measured off a real slide, so when you rebuild it in Claude Design Slides keep the positions and sizes in the preview exactly: change the words, not the grid. Build the text and shapes from the Elements cards, each of which ends with its Slides recipe.

# RelTaxonomyBands

A taxonomy that divides the whole space.

## When to use it

Three to five named classes that between them exhaust a space.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | F-relational |
| Form | taxonomy |
| Arity | 4 |
| Ground | cream |
| Density | standard, about 560 characters |
| Media | motif |
| Focal | className at 46px against a 64px headline (ratio 0.72) |

## Why it holds together

The class names carry the slide; the members are supporting detail set at body size. Inverting that ratio turns a taxonomy into four lists.

## Deviations from the traced source

| What | Source | Here | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| the source's central infographic | three-circle Venn inside a radial dial with an arrow loop | a motif slot | One-off artwork drawn for one argument. Nothing about it generalises, and a template that claimed to carry it would be lying about what it is. |
| class names printing through their members | SHARED and EARNED both do it | fixed | A defect in the source. Its left-hand legend also overlaps itself so badly that two of four labels are unreadable. |
